# javaabu/js-localization

> Puts a Laravel app's translations in JavaScript, for @javaabu/i18n's __(), trans() and trans_choice(), which match Laravel's. Blade pages get the helpers on window with no setup (a script delivered through javaabu/manifest that loads lines from a cached endpoint); Inertia/SPA bundles load them from a Vite plugin, one lazy chunk per locale, with HMR when lang/ changes. Commands: lang:js (export files), lang:missing (keys and lines a locale lacks, for CI), lang:translate (fill in missing lines with AI through laravel/ai).

Paths are relative to this file. In an app, that's vendor/javaabu/js-localization/.

## Rules

- Never hard-code user-facing text in JS. Use `__('Save')` (English text as the key, from lang/{locale}.json) or a group key like `__('messages.welcome', { app })`, the same keys as PHP. Pass values as placeholders, never by joining strings.
- Blade pages: `__()`, `trans()`, `trans_choice()` and `I18n` are on `window` automatically. Wait for them in inline scripts: `document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => { await I18n.ready(); ... })`. Don't add `<script>` tags for @javaabu/i18n or for a messages file.
- Inertia/React/Vue: add `jsLocalization()` from `./vendor/javaabu/js-localization/dist/vite.js` next to `manifest()` in vite.config.js, then `configure({ loader })` with `loader` from `@javaabu/js-localization/translations` in the entry. Use `useTranslation()` from `@javaabu/i18n/react` in components (Vue: `app.use(i18n)` from `@javaabu/i18n/vue`).
- Don't commit generated translation files or run `php artisan lang:js` in build scripts when the Vite plugin or the endpoint already provide the lines.
- Add new lines to lang/ files in every locale the app has (at least `en` and `dv`), with real Dhivehi in Thaana. Run `php artisan lang:missing` to check; it exits non-zero when something is missing.
- Everything exported is public. Keep private text out with `js-localization.except` (wildcards, group names as in `__()`: `admin`, `emails/*`, `pkg::*`).
- `php artisan lang:translate --to=dv` needs laravel/ai. It only adds missing lines and rejects broken placeholders/plurals/tags; review its report and the diff before committing. Use `TranslationAgent::fake()` in tests, never real API calls.
- Group keys keep Laravel's names in JS: `forum/thread.title`, `shop::cart.empty`.
